channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Koby Altman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Koby Altman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Koby Altman, Mike Gansey, LeBron James
item.description:
Danny Cunningham:Donovan Mitchell on if he wants LeBron James to return:

“That is not for me. I am not trying to get a headline. That's a Koby Altman question, that's a Mike Gansey question.”

Donovan Mitchell on Koby Altman, Mike Gansey, LeBron James, May 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lindsay Gottlieb on JB Bickerstaff, Koby Altman
item.description:
Lindsay Gottlieb:

“I am very thankful for the opportunity to serve as an Assistant Coach with the Cavaliers for the last two years. This has truly been a basketball dream come true for me to work not only in the NBA, but hand-in-hand with this incredible coaching staffthat has taught me so much. I’d especially like to thank Koby Altman and J.B. Bickerstaff for believing in me and providing an inclusive environment to enhance my coaching acumen.”

Lindsay Gottlieb on JB Bickerstaff, Koby Altman, May 10, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Koby Altman, John Beilein
item.description:
Dan Gilbert:

“It is no surprise that Koby (Altman) and his team landed on John Beilein as great cultures attract others who hold the same values as the foundation for everything they do. I can’t wait for next season to begin.”

Dan Gilbert on Koby Altman, John Beilein, May 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @CavsJoeG.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Larry Drew, Koby Altman
item.description:
#Cavs owner Dan Gilbert on acting coach Larry Drew wanted his contract restructured:

“I think Larry Drew is one of my favorite guys, favorite coaches, but I just don’t think it’s appropriate to comment on Koby (Altman's) and Larry Drew’s negotiations.”

Dan Gilbert on Larry Drew, Koby Altman, Nov 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @MRidenourABJ.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Koby Altman
item.description:
Lue said following Friday's practice.

“We want to give guys a chance to play and kind of see what they do when the lights are on instead of just practice. Talking to (general manager) Koby (Altman), that's the right thing to do. We will see how it goes tomorrow.”

Tyronn Lue on Koby Altman, Oct 5, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
